name: qa-overstrict-gate-workflow
description: Workflow variant of qa-overstrict-gate. Uses two-phase enforcement (Method #15) to force QA to diagnose test failures BEFORE writing a verdict. Phase 1 runs tests, reads error output, and documents which failures are environment-related vs patch-related. Phase 2 writes the verdict based on Phase 1's root-cause analysis. This prevents OVER-STRICT_GATE — the agent cannot reflexively FAIL because vitest returned non-zero without first documenting WHY it failed.
